serb.definition: n a member of a Slavic people who settled in Serbia and neighboring areas in the 6th and 7th centuries
serb.translation:
n. 塞尔维亚人[语]
a. 塞尔维亚的, 塞尔维亚人[语]的

serb-croat.translation: abbr. Serbo-Croatian 塞波-克罗地亚语（斯拉夫语）

serbia.definition: n. a historical region in central and northern Yugoslavia; Serbs settled the region in the 6th and 7th centuries
serbia.translation: n. 塞尔维亚（南斯拉夫成员共和国名）

serbia and montenegro.translation: [网络] 塞尔维亚和黑山；塞黑；塞尔维亚马其顿

serbian.definition:
n. a member of a Slavic people who settled in Serbia and neighboring areas in the 6th and 7th centuries
a. of or relating to the people or language or culture of the region of Serbia
serbian.translation: a. 塞尔维亚人（语）的；塞尔维亚的

serbians.definition:
plural of serbian
n. a member of a Slavic people who settled in Serbia and neighboring areas in the 6th and 7th centuries
a. of or relating to the people or language or culture of the region of Serbia
serbians.translation: (serbian 的复数) adj. 塞尔维亚人（语）的；塞尔维亚的

serbo-croat.definition: n. the Slavic language of the Serbs and Croats; the Serbian dialect is usually written in the Cyrillic alphabet and the Croatian dialect is usually written in the Roman alphabet
serbo-croat.translation: n. （前南斯拉夫使用的）塞尔维亚－克罗地亚语

serbo-croatian.definition: n the Slavic language of the Serbs and Croats; the Serbian dialect is usually written in the Cyrillic alphabet and the Croatian dialect is usually written in the Roman alphabet
serbo-croatian.translation: n. 塞尔维亚-克罗地亚语

serbo-croats.translation: (serbo-croat 的复数) n. （前南斯拉夫使用的）塞尔维亚－克罗地亚语

serbonian.definition:
a. Relating to the lake of Serbonis in Egypt, which by
   reason of the sand blowing into it had a deceptive appearance of being
   solid land, but was a bog.
serbonian.translation: a. (古埃及北部)塞波尼斯(Serbonis)大沼泽的

serbs.definition: n a member of a Slavic people who settled in Serbia and neighboring areas in the 6th and 7th centuries
serbs.translation: n. 塞尔维亚人（Serb的复数形式）
